Oh, a weredragon and humans...What a rare sight!\nWhat brings you to a place like this?
We came here because we heard that the royal\ndragon cocoon is being targeted by the minions of\nthe Imperial Dragon! Where are they?!
W-what? The Coenubia seems to be protecting the\nroyal dragon cocoon. What's going on here???!
What a pathetic shapeless and weak creature!\nYou think you can beat me...?
Oh no, it's taking over the dragon!!
Stupid dragon...Did you really think destroying\nthe cocoon would make me happy...?
Your plan was smart!\nNo one would suspect that it was just a bait\nwhen it was being heavily guarded like this...
As expected, you can't be fooled easily...\nIt seems like you don't call yourself the\nImperial Dragon for nothing...
Vasaria, the goddess of water commanded me to\nprotect the fake cocoon properly to divert the\ndragons' attention away from the real one...
Where's the real royal dragon cocoon then...?
I don't know either, but it should be receiving\nthe power emitted from the weredragons' vital\npoint somewhere now in preparation for hatching...
Hahaha, great, excellent! That must be the case...\nI can't wait for the royal dragon to be born...
It must be fate that we keep running into each\nother...\nLet's meet again someday...
By the way, if this isn't a cocoon, what is it\nthen...?
It's something I had in our world.\nVasaria did something to make it look like a\ncocoon...
It's what you humans call Goddess Bead or crysta.
What?! Goddess Bead? Crysta!\nIt's quite rare to find a natural crystal as big\nas this, you know?!
Oh dear, it's unfortunate that it shattered!\nLemme get the largest piece...
Dang, it's you again!\nWhat are you gonna do with that?!
